fullText.simplified:
第二十六章、南柳星

    简西在这一刻把一切都告诉石文谦。
    “我知道密室壁画上的全部信息。壁画上宝珠偏向西北方，所以我从一开始就知道要往西北方向走。还有壁画宝珠上的黑点，我也知道那代表着什么。”简西说道。
    “我判断和星象有关，对吗？”石文谦早就观察到了那些黑点，魔鬼城的圆球上也有相似的凸点。
    “你说得没错。现在的星空有十二个星座，比如白羊座、狮子座、双鱼座等等，但是中国古代的天文学家为了观察宇宙运行的规律，把天空的星星划分为二十八个星宿，比如鬼星、角星等等。这二十八个星宿又被归到东南西北四个大区域里，分别是东方青龙、南方朱雀、西方白虎和北方玄武。也就是说东方青龙所在的区域包括七个星宿，南方朱雀所在的区域包括七个星宿，西方白虎所在的区域包括七个星宿，北方玄武的地区也包括七个星宿。你还记得壁画宝珠上的那些若隐若现的黑点吗？那就是二十八星宿中的一个。”简西做了清晰的解释。
    “是哪一个星宿？”石文谦问道。
    “是南方朱雀所在区域内的南柳星。”简西回答道。
    石文谦知道南柳星，南柳星在南方，它的形状有一点儿像勺子。但是只凭几个点，就能确定这是南柳星吗？他曾在资料室里研究过一本《二十八星宿探秘》的书，他记得南柳星和北斗星的形状很相似，所以简西是怎么确定的呢？
    “你是怎么知道的？”石文谦直接问道。
    “我从爷爷的笔记本上看到的。我爷爷是一个天文学家，我从小就看各种星图。更重要的是，我也在爷爷的本子上看到了一些记录，那是关于我们家族守护的秘密。这个秘密由两个部分组成，一个是星图，代表方位，另一个是地点，代表起始点。把这两部分组合在一起，我们就能找到那个秘密，也就是传说中的宝藏。”简西回忆着本子上的内容，尽量简短地表达了她知道的线索，她还想继续说下去，但是被石文谦打断了。
    “对不起，简西，我打断一下。”石文谦坐直了身体，说道：“你们家族也在保护一些秘密。所以我可以这样理解吗？河洛村就是起始点，现在我们已经在这个起始点了。然后你知道宝藏的方向，准确说这个方向和南柳星有关，然后沿着这个方向走，就可以找到宝藏？”石文谦边说边用手在空气里画了画。
    “是的。”简西点点头。
fullText.traditional:
第二十六章、南柳星

    簡西在這一刻把一切都告訴石文謙。
    “我知道密室壁畫上的全部信息。壁畫上寶珠偏向西北方，所以我從一開始就知道要往西北方向走。還有壁畫寶珠上的黑點，我也知道那代表著什麼。”簡西說道。
    “我判斷和星象有關，對嗎？”石文謙早就觀察到了那些黑點，魔鬼城的圓球上也有相似的凸點。
    “你說得沒錯。現在的星空有十二個星座，比如白羊座、獅子座、雙魚座等等，但是中國古代的天文學家為了觀察宇宙運行的規律，把天空的星星劃分為二十八個星宿，比如鬼星、角星等等。這二十八個星宿又被歸到東南西北四個大區域裡，分別是東方青龍、南方朱雀、西方白虎和北方玄武。也就是說東方青龍所在的區域包括七個星宿，南方朱雀所在的區域包括七個星宿，西方白虎所在的區域包括七個星宿，北方玄武的地區也包括七個星宿。你還記得壁畫寶珠上的那些若隱若現的黑點嗎？那就是二十八星宿中的一個。”簡西做了清晰的解釋。
    “是哪一個星宿？”石文謙問道。
    “是南方朱雀所在區域內的南柳星。”簡西回答道。
    石文謙知道南柳星，南柳星在南方，它的形狀有一點兒像勺子。但是只憑幾個點，就能確定這是南柳星嗎？他曾在資料室裡研究過一本《二十八星宿探祕》的書，他記得南柳星和北斗星的形狀很相似，所以簡西是怎麼確定的呢？
    “你是怎麼知道的？”石文謙直接問道。
    “我從爺爺的筆記本上看到的。我爺爺是一個天文學家，我從小就看各種星圖。更重要的是，我也在爺爺的本子上看到了一些記錄，那是關於我們家族守護的秘密。這個秘密由兩個部分組成，一個是星圖，代表方位，另一個是地點，代表起始點。把這兩部分組合在一起，我們就能找到那個秘密，也就是傳說中的寶藏。”簡西回憶著本子上的內容，儘量簡短地表達了她知道的線索，她還想繼續說下去，但是被石文謙打斷了。
    “對不起，簡西，我打斷一下。”石文謙坐直了身體，說道：“你們家族也在保護一些秘密。所以我可以這樣理解嗎？河洛村就是起始點，現在我們已經在這個起始點了。然後你知道寶藏的方向，準確說這個方向和南柳星有關，然後沿著這個方向走，就可以找到寶藏？”石文謙邊說邊用手在空氣裡畫了畫。
    “是的。”簡西點點頭。

sentences.simplified: 石文谦坐直了身体，说道：“你们家族也在保护一些秘密。所以我可以这样理解吗？
sentences.traditional: 石文謙坐直了身體，說道：“你們家族也在保護一些秘密。所以我可以這樣理解嗎？
sentences.pinyin: shí wén qiān zuò zhí le shēn tǐ shuō dào nǐ men jiā zú yě zài bǎo hù yì xiē mì mì suǒ yǐ wǒ kě yǐ zhè yàng lǐ jiě ma
sentences.english: Shi Wenqian sat up straight and said, “Your family is also guarding some secrets. So can I think of it in this way?

sentences.simplified: 河洛村就是起始点，现在我们已经在这个起始点了。
sentences.traditional: 河洛村就是起始點，現在我們已經在這個起始點了。
sentences.pinyin: hé luò cūn jiù shì qǐ shǐ diǎn xiàn zài wǒ men yǐ jīng zài zhè ge qǐ shǐ diǎn le
sentences.english: Heluo Village is the starting point. Right now we are already at this starting point.

sentences.simplified: 然后你知道宝藏的方向，
sentences.traditional: 然後你知道寶藏的方向，
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu nǐ zhī dào bǎo zàng de fāng xiàng
sentences.english: And then, you know the direction of the treasure.

sentences.simplified: 准确说这个方向和南柳星有关，然后沿着这个方向走，就可以找到宝藏？”
sentences.traditional: 準確說這個方向和南柳星有關，然後沿著這個方向走，就可以找到寶藏？”
sentences.pinyin: zhǔn què shuō zhè ge fāng xiàng hé nán liǔ xīng yǒu guān rán hòu yán zhe zhè ge fāng xiàng zǒu jiù kě yǐ zhǎo dào bǎo zàng
sentences.english: To be precise, this direction has to do with the Southern Willow Mansion, and if we follow this direction, we can find the treasure?”

sentences.simplified: 石文谦边说边用手在空气里画了画。
sentences.traditional: 石文謙邊說邊用手在空氣裡畫了畫。
sentences.pinyin: shí wén qiān biān shuō biān yòng shǒu zài kōng qì lǐ huà le huà
sentences.english: Shi Wenqian spoke while drawing in the air with his hand.

sentences.simplified: “是的。”简西点点头。
sentences.traditional: “是的。”簡西點點頭。

sentences.english: “Yes,” Jian Xi nodded.

sentence_translations: Chapter 26: Southern Willow Mansion
At this moment, Jian Xi told Shi Wenqian everything.
“I know all the information on the mural in the secret chamber.
The mural shows the pearl leaning toward the northwest, so I knew from the start that we had to go northwest.
Also, the black dots on the pearl, I know what those represent, too,” Jian Xi said.
“I’m guessing it has to do with the configuration of the stars, right?”
Shi Wenqian had noticed those black dots long ago. There were also similar protrusions on the sphere in Devil City.
“You’re right. Nowadays, the night sky has 12 constellations, such as Aries, Leo, Pisces, and so on.
However, in order to observe the laws of the universe, ancient Chinese astronomers divided the stars in the sky into 28 mansions, ..
.. such as the Ghost and the Horn.
These 28 mansions were also divided into the four major regions of east, south, west, and north.
They are the Azure Dragon of the East, the Vermilion Bird of the South, the White Tiger of the West, and the Black Tortoise of the North.
That is to say, the region where the Azure Dragon of the East is located includes seven mansions, ..
.. the region where the Vermilion Bird of the South is located includes seven mansions, ..
.. the region where the White Tiger of the West is located includes seven mansions, ..
.. and the region where the Black Tortoise of the North is located also includes seven mansions.
Do you still remember those faint black dots on the pearl in the mural?
That is one of the 28 mansions.” Jian Xi gave a clear explanation.
“Which of the mansions is it?” Shi Wenqian asked.
“It’s the Southern Willow Mansion located in the region of the Vermilion Bird of the South,” Jian Xi replied.
Shi Wenqian knew of the Southern Willow Mansion.
The Southern Willow Mansion is in the south, and its shape is a bit like a spoon.
But could they be sure that this was the Southern Willow Mansion just on the basis of these few points?
He once studied a book called “Exploring the Mysteries of the Twenty-Eight Mansions” in the reference room.
He remembered that the shape of the Southern Willow Mansion was very similar to that of the Big Dipper. So how could Jian Xi be sure?
“How do you know?” Shi Wenqian asked directly.
“I saw it in my grandfather’s notebook. My grandfather was an astronomer, and I have looked at various star charts since I was a child.
More importantly, I also saw some records in my grandfather’s notebook, which were about the secret our family is guarding.
This secret consists of two parts.
One is a star chart, representing direction, and the other is a location, representing the starting point.
By combining these two parts, we can find the secret, which is also the legendary treasure.”
Jian Xi was thinking back to the content of the notebook, expressing the clues she knew as concisely as possible.
She wanted to continue speaking but was interrupted by Shi Wenqian.
“Sorry, Jian Xi, let me interrupt for a moment.”
Shi Wenqian sat up straight and said, “Your family is also guarding some secrets. So can I think of it in this way?
Heluo Village is the starting point. Right now we are already at this starting point.
And then, you know the direction of the treasure.
To be precise, this direction has to do with the Southern Willow Mansion, and if we follow this direction, we can find the treasure?”
Shi Wenqian spoke while drawing in the air with his hand.
“Yes,” Jian Xi nodded.
